title: Native interop operations
description: The conversions between native time types and UTV. Each JSON-layer function returns a UtvResult (or Err(UtvResult)) named convert; each From/TryFrom impl on a typed value returns the value or Err(Diagnostics). All are queries: they build a new value and change nothing.

entities.name: Take a SystemTime reading
entities.description: A SystemTime the caller read becomes a POSIX instant, exactly to the nanosecond, before or after the epoch.
entities.transport: exported function utv::interop::from_system_time; typed form Instant::from_system_time
entities.result: unique with the instant, operation convert; Instant::from_system_time returns the Instant itself.
failures: unsupported (implementation-limit) if the reading's seconds don't fit the arithmetic; no SystemTime reaches it in practice.

entities.name: Write an instant as a SystemTime
entities.description: A POSIX instant becomes a SystemTime, checked by converting it back.
entities.transport: exported function utv::interop::to_system_time; typed form SystemTime::try_from(instant)
entities.result: Ok(SystemTime) that converts back to the same instant.
failures: unsupported (precision-loss) when the instant has a fraction finer than a nanosecond, or finer than this platform's SystemTime holds (the round trip differs).
unsupported (out-of-native-range) outside the range of SystemTime on this platform.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for a value that is not a POSIX instant, such as a civil date.

entities.name: Take a chrono naive date, time or date-time
entities.description: NaiveDate becomes a date, NaiveTime a time (always with a second), NaiveDateTime an unzoned date-time: not read as local time or as UTC.
entities.transport: exported functions utv::interop::chrono::from_naive_date, from_naive_time, from_naive_date_time; typed forms CivilDate::from, CivilTime::try_from, CivilDateTime::try_from (feature chrono)
entities.result: unique with the civil value, operation convert, or the typed value.
failures: unsupported (leap-second) for chrono's leap-second representation (a nanosecond field of 10^9 or more).

entities.name: Take a chrono DateTime<FixedOffset> with a named intent
entities.description: The caller says what the value means: a point on the timeline (an instant; the offset was only how it was written) or a wall time at that offset (a fixed-offset date-time).
entities.transport: exported function utv::interop::chrono::from_fixed_offset(dt, OffsetIntent); typed forms Instant::try_from(dt) and FixedOffsetDateTime::try_from(dt) (feature chrono)
entities.result: An instant, or a datetime with a fixed-offset zone, as the intent says.
failures: invalid (offset-out-of-range) from FixedOffsetDateTime::try_from when chrono's offset is beyond ±18:00, which the typed reader refuses.

entities.name: Take a chrono DateTime<Utc>
entities.description: A DateTime<Utc> becomes a POSIX instant, exactly to the nanosecond.
entities.transport: exported function utv::interop::chrono::from_utc; typed form Instant::try_from(dt) (feature chrono)
entities.result: unique with the instant, operation convert, or the Instant.

entities.name: Refuse a chrono DateTime<Local>
entities.description: A value tied to the host's time zone is never interpreted. There is no From/TryFrom for it on any typed value.
entities.result: Always unsupported (local-zone), operation convert; the message points to from_fixed_offset or from_utc.

entities.name: Write a date, time or date-time as a chrono naive value
entities.description: An unzoned date, time or date-time becomes NaiveDate, NaiveTime (a missing second becomes 0) or NaiveDateTime.
entities.transport: exported functions utv::interop::chrono::to_naive_date, to_naive_time, to_naive_date_time; typed forms NaiveDate::try_from, NaiveTime::from, NaiveDateTime::try_from (feature chrono)
failures: unsupported (zone-dropped) for a zoned or fixed-offset value: the naive type would drop the zone (JSON-layer functions only; the typed sources are unzoned).
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for another kind or form.
unsupported (out-of-native-range) for a year outside chrono's range, about ±262 000.

entities.name: Write a fixed-offset date-time as a chrono DateTime<FixedOffset>
entities.description: A wall time at a fixed offset becomes the same wall time and offset in chrono, exactly.
entities.transport: exported function utv::interop::chrono::to_fixed_offset; typed form DateTime::<FixedOffset>::try_from(value) (feature chrono)
failures: unsupported (zone-dropped) for a named-zone value, even with an offsetAssertion: FixedOffset would keep the offset and drop the zone's rules.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for an unzoned date-time, or another kind or form.

entities.name: Write an instant as a chrono DateTime<Utc>
entities.description: A POSIX instant becomes a DateTime<Utc>, exactly.
entities.transport: exported function utv::interop::chrono::to_utc; typed form DateTime::<Utc>::try_from(instant) (feature chrono)
failures: unsupported (precision-loss) for a fraction finer than a nanosecond.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for a value that is not a POSIX instant.
